headline: Fresh Assaults Stir the Strategic Front
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows fresh movement on several fronts, though the heaviest action remains concentrated in a few sectors. Linn Mercy leads the day’s base activity with 29 recorded events and two in the latest two hours; its present line stands at nine Warden-held bases against two Colonial. Fisherman’s Row is also newly active, with four events in two hours and 15 in the day, leaving six Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral position. Stlican Shelf has posted two fresh events and six across 24 hours, while Stonecradle recorded five in six hours and 12 in the day despite a presently all-Warden board. Endless Shore remains a major battleground at 21 daily events, though none arrived in the latest two hours; all ten current bases are Colonial-held. Deadlands is still the most violently contested by casualty volume, with ten daily ownership events and an even split of five Warden to six Colonial bases. Elsewhere, many sectors show enlistments or fighting without recent base changes.
